newsitem.title: UK: British Airways firms on USAir share sale.
newsitem.headline: British Airways firms on USAir share sale.

text.p: Shares in British Airways were firmer in pre-market trade on Wednesday after the airline said it planned to sell its 25 percent stake in U.S. carrier USAir.
British Airways shares were indicated 8-1/2p higher at 600p at 0804 GMT.
The advance, however, was likely to be limited, dealers said.
"The shares have had a good run," said one. "People figured (British Airways) was going to do it some time and from the looks of things, the sale will only make a small profit."

The British airline, required to offer the shares to USAir before selling them, said it was not disclosing the price it has offered, and USAir has 60 days to accept. British Airways said the sale had not resulted from USAir's recent lawsuit against BA related to the British carrier's proposed strategic alliance with American Airlines.

"British Airways has taken this action with regret. But it has become inevitable. It would clearly be unwise to pursue an alliance with an unwilling partner. We still believe the legal action to be groundless," the company said in a statement.
